name: Department access retained after an observed transfer
what_it_establishes: deterministic; re-derivable from two HR snapshots
notes: Transfers are derived by comparing consecutive HR extracts, not read from any field asserting a move. 17 transfers observed across 10 snapshots. | 29 entitlements were identified as department-scoped by measuring how concentrated their holders are, rather than by matching a naming convention.

name: High-risk access rare within the peer group
what_it_establishes: statistical; a ranking signal, not a violation
notes: 88 workers sit in peer groups below 8 members and were not evaluated. In a group that small every member is an outlier by construction. | Severity is capped at MEDIUM for this rule. A statistical signal does not establish that access is wrong, only that it is unusual, and escalating it alongside deterministic findings would misrepresent how much argument it will take to defend.

name: Elevated-risk access not exercised
notes: Threshold is 180 days and is a policy choice, not a discovered value. Every finding restates it so the reader can judge the finding against their own standard.

name: Emergency access held continuously
what_it_establishes: deterministic; re-derivable from two HR snapshots
notes: Continuity is established over a 119-day window. A grant issued and surrendered between two snapshots is invisible to this check; the snapshot interval is the resolution limit.
